mapper.select: SELECT news_id, team_id, news_path, news_time, headline, state, title,content,tag FROM news WHERE state = 1 ORDER BY news_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM news WHERE state = 1
SELECT * FROM news WHERE state = 1 AND headline = 1 ORDER BY news_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT * FROM news WHERE state = 1 AND headline = 0 ORDER BY news_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM news WHERE state = 1 AND headline = 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM news WHERE state = 1 AND headline = 0
SELECT headline FROM news WHERE news_id = #{newsId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO news (team_id, news_path, news_time, headline, state, title, content, tag) VALUES (#{news.teamId}, #{news.newsPath}, #{news.newsTime}, 0, 0, #{news.title}, #{news.content}, #{news.tag})
